Complete lesson: Spread, Fee & Stop-Loss Basics
Trade at least %1$d distinct fictional assets
Attach or place Stop-Loss on at least %1$d trades
Pass %1$d Candle Reading drills in Risk-Free Practice
Place %1$d trades with Stop-Loss risk <= 2%% equity
Every trade pays a bid-ask spread and simulation commission (10 bps). Always define your Stop-Loss exit BEFORE entering so a routine pullback never turns into an uncontrolled loss.
Risking 1–2% of equity per Stop-Loss means dividing your risk budget by |Entry − StopLoss|. Pairing Limit entries with OCO Take-Profit / Stop-Loss keeps Risk/Reward skewed in your favor.
Candlestick wicks reveal where buyers or sellers fought back, while Market Regimes (Bull, Bear, Sideways, Crisis) shift overall volatility and trend behavior.
Leverage and Short Selling deduct daily borrow fees per tick and trigger Margin Call at 110% and Forced Liquidation at 100%. Use small size and firm Stop-Losses.
